$$
F(x,y,z)=\left\langle y,\,2 x,\,z\right\rangle,

$$
\iint_S F\cdot\mathrm{d}\mathbf{S}=\iint_D\left(-P\frac{\partial g}{\partial x}-Q\frac{\partial g}{\partial y}+R\right)\mathrm{d}A.
$$

$$
\begin{aligned}\frac{\partial g}{\partial x} & =\frac{\partial}{\partial x}\left(2 x - 2 y + 1\right)=2 \\ \frac{\partial g}{\partial y} & =\frac{\partial}{\partial y}\left(2 x - 2 y + 1\right)=-2\end{aligned}
$$

Next, we substitute the equation $z=g(x,y)$ into $F(x,y,z):$

$$
\begin{aligned}F(x,y,g(x,y)) & =\left\langle y,\,2 x,\,z\right\rangle\big|_{z=2 x - 2 y + 1} \\  & =\left\langle y,\,2 x,\,\left(2 x - 2 y + 1\right)\right\rangle \\  & =\left\langle \underbrace{y}_{P},\,\underbrace{2 x}_{Q},\,\underbrace{2 x - 2 y + 1}_{R}\right\rangle\end{aligned}
